description: This source file provides an implementation of the ITestClusterPortAllocator interface, specifically a class named TestClusterPortAllocator. It is responsible for allocating unused TCP port pairs for testing clusters, managing synchronization via mutexes, and ensuring ports are available and not in conflict.

classes.name: TestClusterPortAllocator
classes.description: Implements port allocation logic for testing clusters, including methods to allocate port pairs, dispose resources, and internal logic for port and mutex management.

classes.name: MutexManager
classes.description: A singleton class managing mutexes to synchronize port resource allocation across concurrent processes, implemented with a background worker thread.

methods.name: AllocateConsecutivePortPairs
methods.description: Allocates two sets of consecutive TCP port pairs for testing, each set having 'numPorts' ports, by checking system TCP listeners.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes of resources, releasing held mutexes and marking the allocator as disposed.

methods.name: Dispose(bool)
methods.description: Helper method for disposing managed and unmanaged resources.

methods.name: GetAvailableConsecutiveServerPorts
methods.description: Finds a range of available consecutive ports within the specified range that are not currently in use.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Background thread method that processes mutex acquire and release requests.

methods.name: Acquire
methods.description: Attempts to acquire a named mutex, blocking until it succeeds or times out.

methods.name: SignalRelease
methods.description: Releases a mutex with the specified name, signaling that the port is now free.

methods.name: OnAppDomainUnload
methods.description: Event handler to shutdown the mutex management thread during domain unload.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Stops the mutex management thread safely.
